title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary: Completed the evaluation of RecSys-v2 vs RecSys-v1. Generated plots comparing offline and online metrics. Wrote a comprehensive report in report/report.md detailing the methodology, results, and a strong recommendation NOT to launch RecSys-v2 due to severe degradation in long-term retention, catalog coverage, and user complaint rates, despite short-term gains in CTR and top-k precision.
